## [1.3.3] - 2026-11-07

Release 1.3.3. A fix for every venue with an AtlasIED Atmosphere: the AZM numbers its mixes after its source slots,
so no mix was ever found on real hardware and a zone listening to one read "Source 14". Mixes now appear everywhere
they should, a zone on a mix is named, and a zone can be routed to a mix; a firmware without per-source levels inside
its mixes keeps its zones and mixes and says so on the device's page.

### Fixed

- **Mixes on a real Atmosphere.** An AZM numbers its mixes after its source slots, in the same space a zone's source
  value uses (`MixName_14` and up on an AZM8, 8 and up on an AZM4; the AtlasIED manual's "use the number after the
  underscore in SourceName" and the Crestron module's "Parameter Index 14 for the mix"), and discovery only probed
  `MixName_0…7`: no mix was ever found, and a zone listening to one read "Source 14". Discovery now probes the whole
  range, the strips name such a zone's source "<mix> (mix)", the source selects, the rail and the fold-outs offer every
  mix after the sources, and the per-mix source levels are asked for in their own subscription so a firmware without
  them keeps its zones and mixes (the device's page says **Mix sources: …** either way).
